title: chore: add code agent deploy token
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `CODE_AGENT_DEPLOY_API_TOKEN` to Enter staging and production SOPS files.
- Scopes the Cloudflare token to Workers script management on the Enter/Gen account.
- Verified the token is active and can access Workers for Platforms dispatch namespaces.

Supports #14622. No plaintext secret is committed.

gist.headline: A key for the worker shed
gist.blurb: The code agent now has a properly scoped key to the Enter and Gen worker shed. It can tend deployment scripts without leaving any secrets in the flowerbed.
gist.summary: Added the encrypted CODE_AGENT_DEPLOY_API_TOKEN to Enter staging and production SOPS files, scoped for Cloudflare Workers script management and dispatch namespace access on the Enter/Gen account.
gist.impact: This gives the code agent authenticated, environment-specific access to manage Enter and Gen Cloudflare Workers deployments while keeping the token out of plaintext source control.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed deployment scene: Polli uses a tiny key to open a labeled Workers tool cabinet while a friendly CRT monitor robot checks two sealed staging and production seed packets. A glowing lime-green terminal and sprouting code-plants represent securely managed deployment access rather than exposed credentials.
